meta.method: GitHub REST API observations (repo meta, releases, README) for GitHub URLs; page observations for other hosts. The automatic rubric caps at Class 1. Class 0 requires a manual review of scope, version and primary evidence in data/evidence-class-zero-reviews.json. Unavailable or unreadable sources are marked unknown, not as notes. Entries observed on 2026-11-02 keep their original checked_at; Class 0 reviews refreshed from 2026-11-03 pinned README commits, and entries added to the catalog later were observed on 2026-11-04.

rubric.0: A manually confirmed full software reconstruction (kind: case-study) whose scope, version and primary evidence were reviewed. The automatic rubric never assigns Class 0.
rubric.1: Automatic maximum: download and non-branding demo exist; scope may be partial, or the entry is a tool, integration, guide or binary-analysis entry.
rubric.2: Demo or download missing; code and documentation exist, so buildability stays unknown.
rubric.3: No code or no documentation: progress notes or notebook entries only.
rubric.unknown: Source unavailable or unreadable at review time; not classified.
